known_issues.description: pv3_power returns ~52.5W (firmware artifact, constant) when no PV3 string is installed. pv3_current shows ~0.1A residual offset despite Vpv3=0V. Mitigated by enabled_by_default:false on pv3_* sensors.
known_issues.follow_up: Add ESPHome lambda clamp: pv3_power_effective = (pv3_voltage > 50V) ? pv3_power : 0. Scope: Generator extension or registry lambda field.

known_issues.description: In V0.20 firmware (HR73=20), Modbus input registers 44-45 (Pac2) and 48-49 (Pac3) always return [0,0] despite L2/L3 currents being present. Addr 40-41 (Pac1 in V1.24) = total 3-phase active power in V0.20, not L1 only. Verified 2026-03-13 via mbpoll FC04 under 3-phase oven load (~5A/phase balanced): 3×4.8A×(415V/√3)=3450W matches raw/0.1=3448W.
known_issues.mitigation: ac_power_l1 renamed to ac_power_total (hard rename, not yet integrated in dashboards). ac_power_l2 and ac_power_l3 set to enabled_by_default:false + entity_category:diagnostic.
known_issues.version_dependency: V0.20 only (HR73=20). V1.24 per-phase layout may be correct on newer firmware — re-verify before re-enabling.

numbers.liability_warning: Grid First Timeslot 1 start time. Raw uint16 encoding: high byte = hour (0-23), low byte = minute (0-59). Example: 00:00 = 0, 23:59 = 5947. PVAutonomy automation uses fixed value 0 (00:00) for all-day slot. Do not set arbitrary values without understanding the encoding.
numbers.note: HR1080: Grid First Timeslot 1 Start Time per Growatt SPH v1.24 official protocol. Encoding: (hour << 8) + minute. numbers.name: Export Limit Power Rate

write_policy.note: Field test 2026-03-14: HR123 writes confirmed working directly via ESPHome Modbus without unlock sequence. Device accepts raw 0–1000, silently clamps values above 1000. HR122 (ExportLimitEnable mode select) unlock requirement not verified separately.

numbers.note: Percent of inverter rated AC power. Raw register range: 0–1000 (1 raw unit = 0.1%, 1000 raw = 100.0%). scale=10: ESPHome multiply=10. ESPHome number semantics: READ state=raw/multiply, WRITE raw=value*multiply. So: READ raw/10 (700→70%), WRITE value*10 (70%→700). Range 0–100%, step 0.1%. Only active when HR122 (ExportLimitEnable) ≠ 0. Chint DTSU666 Smart Meter required for closed-loop control. Scale history: 0.1(wrong,S_WORD)→1(wrong,clamps at 1000W)→10(wrong,unit=W)→0.1(wrong,factor-100 write error)→10(correct,unit=%,verified ESPHome multiply semantics).

numbers.liability_warning: Full-word write to HR1102 overwrites all mode control bits. Use individual bit switches where possible.
numbers.note: ⚠️ UNVERIFIED — dual-use address collision unresolved. HR1102: this entry treats HR1102 as a full-word Load First mode control register, but bit0 of HR1102 is also mapped by battery_first_timeslot_1_enabled (switch). Full-word write overwrites all bits including the timeslot-enable bit. The collision between full-word semantics and bit-switch semantics is not resolved by device test. Do not use both entries simultaneously. Phase-B device test required before using this register in production. Haus-01 scanned (M5Stack) but write conflict not tested. [EPIC-010 2026-03-28]

numbers.note: ⚠️ INOFFICIAL — HR3135 is NOT documented in Growatt SPH v1.24. Address lies outside the official SPH storage holding register range (1000–1124). STRONGEST available unlock evidence: working M5Stack implementation (Haus-01, archive-core2-sph10k-2025-12) uses the sequence HR3135=0 → HR3136/3137/3138=password. This is the preferred unlock entry point for accessing protected registers (3165, 3046/APR). Still unofficial relative to strict v1.24 PDF. Tier=unsafe. [EPIC-010 2026-03-28]

numbers.name: Battery First Charge Stop SoC
numbers.write_precondition: HR1044=1 (Battery First mode active). No Modbus unlock (HR3135-3138) required — HR1091 is in the standard R/W holding range 1000-1124.
numbers.note: WRITE-PATH CONCLUSION (EPIC-010 2026-03-29/31): HR1091 is the canonical write path for Battery First Charge Stop SoC. Evidence: (1) Growatt v1.24 official name 'wBatFirst stop SOC' (holding, standard R/W range). (2) M5Stack Haus-01 used charge_stop_soc_all_modes number entity at HR1091 — write confirmed from that system. (3) Adjacent HR1090/HR1092 are confirmed writable. (4) HR1100-1108 are Battery First time-slot registers, NOT SoC controls (old assumption corrected). 'No permission' on direct raw writes was a mode-context issue (HR1044 not set to 1 before write). HR1041 is a mirror/readback path. Live SPH10K Home 02 validation confirmed truthful write/readback behavior. Customer dashboard may surface this control contextually under Battery First.

switches.note: HR1112 bit0: Load First main enable switch. When disabled, SPH10K falls back to Battery First. Haus-01 verified (M5Stack).

selects.name: Work Mode
selects.note: CRITICAL ADDRESS CONFLICT: HR1080 = Grid First Timeslot 1 Start Time (hour-encoded, 0-23) per Growatt SPH v1.24 official protocol (see growatt_sph_battery_register_uebersicht.md line 110). NOT a work-mode register. This registry entry at HR1080 is at an incorrect address and must not be used as mode control. HR1044 (priority_control) is the confirmed mode register — writes 0=Load First ✅ stable, 1=Battery First ✅ stable. Generator hard-blocked via generator_skip:true so this select cannot be emitted even in unsafe firmware until the conflict is resolved. [Evidence: SPH_Verifizierte_Register.md, growatt_sph_battery_register_uebersicht_pvautonomy.md] [EPIC-010 2026-03-29]

selects.name: Priority Control
selects.liability_warning: Changing priority mode affects battery charge/discharge behavior and grid interaction. Mode 2=Grid First is context-dependent: requires active Grid First timeslot (HR1082=1) and HR1070/HR1071 configured. Export limit compatibility is firmware-dependent: validated on YBAA-100915 with RS485 Limit active (2026-04-07). See POLICY-GROWATT-SPH-001 Rule 4.
selects.note: HR1044: Confirmed active priority / work-mode register. Historical Haus-01 tests (2025-09-09) showed 0=Load First ✅ stable, 1=Battery First ✅ stable, 2=Grid First sometimes falling back to 0. New live validation on Sph10K Home 02 (2026-03-31) confirms HR1044=2 can function practically as Grid First when supporting context is present: grid_first_discharge_power_rate (HR1070) and grid_first_stop_soc (HR1071) read/write correctly, battery-to-grid export was observed, and export_limit_enable=RS485 acted as a blocking counter-condition. HR3165 (BDC Derating Mode) is a SEPARATE diagnostic/status register — do not confuse with this. HR1080 (work_mode select) has an address conflict (HR1080 = Grid First Timeslot 1 Start Time per v1.24) — HR1044 remains the canonical mode control. Runtime select emission is active; customer dashboard exposure remains gated pending broader product proof. [EPIC-010 2026-03-28/31, 2026-04-08]

selects.name: BDC Derating Mode
selects.note: HR3165: BDC Derating Mode (BDCDeratingMode). Diagnostic/status register, NOT a customer-writable mode and NOT the same as priority_control (HR1044). Kept as generator_skip:true documentation-only value map; the supported product path is a read-only sensor plus a human-readable dashboard status. Renamed from battery_operation_mode per TASK-20260408. [EPIC-010 2026-04-08]

notes.vpp_mode: SPH10K must be set to VPP mode (not Shinemaster) for extended Modbus registers
notes.bms_protocol: BMS Protocol 1.24 - HR3165 is BDCDeratingMode. Under normal operation it should read 0 (Normal unrestricted). This is a BDC/BMS derating-status code, not a priority mode or customer control. Formerly named 'Battery Operation Mode'.
notes.apr_register: HR3 = Active Power Rate (APR) limits total inverter output. Different from HR122/123 which specifically limit grid export.
notes.modbus_version_v020: This device runs Modbus V0.20 (HR73=20), which predates Growatt protocol V1.24. Clean scan 2026-03-12 confirmed: PV string registers IR1-10 follow V1.24 layout exactly (PV total IR1-2, Vpv1 IR3, Ipv1 IR4, Ppv1 IR5-6, Vpv2 IR7, Ipv2 IR8, Ppv2 IR9-10). Battery/power flow registers (IR1000+) and energy counters (IR1044-1063) are well-mapped. Addressing: JSON uses Growatt 0-based addresses; mbpoll 1-based references are offset by +1 vs JSON addresses.
notes.unlock_sequence: Some holding registers (for example HR122 ExportLimitEnable and HR123 ExportLimitPowerRate) require a Modbus 'Unlock Sequence' password write before they can be modified. Sequence: write password to HR3136–3138, then write unlock trigger to HR3135. The Growatt app triggers this automatically; direct Modbus writes may be rejected without unlock. HR3165 is treated by PVAutonomy as a read-only BDC/BMS derating status, not as a supported customer write path. Registry entities: modbus_unlock_control (HR3135), password_reg_1/2/3 (HR3136–3138) — all tier:unsafe.
notes.hr1102_dual_use: HR1102 is used by two registry entities with different semantics: (1) load_first_mode_control (number, full U_WORD write, range 0–65535) and (2) battery_first_timeslot_1_enabled (switch, bit0 read-modify-write). Do not activate both simultaneously in the same firmware build — the full-word write would overwrite the bit0 state. Choose one per device configuration.
notes.scan_2026-03-12: Physical RS485 scan completed 2026-03-12 (Slave ID 1, 9600 8N1). Confirmed: IR0=5→running, IR1-2 DWORD→1000W PV total, IR3=6801→680.1V Vpv1, IR4=14→1.4A Ipv1, IR5-6 DWORD→1005.7W Ppv1, IR7=0→Vpv2=0V, IR1013=2122→212.2V battery, IR1014=97→97% SoC, IR1029-1030→1070W AC output, IR1037-1038→820W local load, IR1021=0W grid (self-sufficient), IR38=5000→50.00Hz, IR93=408→40.8°C inverter temp, IR1088=-20→-0.020A battery current, IR1040=176→17.6°C battery temp, HR3=100→APR 100% (FC03 register 3), HR0=1→inverter running, HR73=20→Modbus V0.20, HR1041=95→Battery First Stop SOC=95%, HR1071=20→battery SoC min grid=20%, HR1091=4996→AC charge power≈5000W. Energy counters IR1044-1063 cross-validated against M5Stack OpenInverter readings. IR113=0→no export derating. HR122=0→export limit disabled. Note: mbpoll uses 1-based addressing (mbpoll[n] = Growatt 0-based address n-1). JSON addresses use Growatt 0-based.
notes.battery_temp_dual: Battery temperature appears at both IR1018 (raw=311, ×0.1=31.1°C) and IR1040 (raw=176, ×0.1=17.6°C). IR1040 confirmed by ESPHome config and scan. IR1018 may be BMS internal sensor vs. external pack sensor.
notes.ac_voltage_3phase: 3-phase AC voltages visible in scan: IR39=4124→412.4V, IR43=4178→417.8V, IR47=3965→396.5V (all ×0.1, plausible L-L 400V values). Not added to registry — V0.20 address offset vs V1.24 unconfirmed. Add after second verification scan.
notes.export_limit_vs_apr: HR3 (APR) and HR122/123 (ExportLimit) are independent controls. APR limits total inverter power output. ExportLimit specifically limits or sets the grid feed-in power. For zero-export without curtailing PV/battery self-consumption, use ExportLimit (HR122=1 RS485, HR123=0) rather than APR. IMPORTANT: HR122 and HR123 writes require Modbus unlock sequence first (HR3135-3138, tier:unsafe). Without unlock, writes are silently ignored by the inverter.
notes.energy_counters_v020: Energy counter registers IR1044-1063 confirmed readable on V0.20 firmware. All 10 energy DWORD pairs cross-validated against M5Stack OpenInverter screenshots (different timestamps — totals show consistent growth). Source: IP-Symcon community NodeJS MQTT code + V1.24 official protocol spec.
notes.smart_meter: Haus-01/02: Chint DTSU666 Smart Meter (RS485, Modbus) connected to SPH10K. Required for closed-loop export limit (HR122/HR123) and AC charge power metering. Field test 2026-03-14: Export limit set to 40% via SPH local menu → confirmed 4000W max feed-in. Modbus HR123 writes via ESPHome confirmed working WITHOUT unlock sequence — device clamps raw values at 1000 (=10000W with scale=10). Earlier note 'no effect without unlock' was incorrect: writes worked but appeared as no-change because scale=1 wrote raw>1000 which the device silently clamped back to 1000. Fix: scale=10 (multiply=10) resolves the clamping issue.
